title: Top-k MoE gating and the Switch load-balancing loss
summary: Route tokens to the top k experts with renormalized softmax gates, and compute the Switch Transformer auxiliary loss E times sum f_i P_i.

paper.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity

mutants.fraction_from_probs: Computes f_i from the mean softmax probability, not from the dispatch counts.
mutants.fraction_over_tokens: Divides the counts by T, not by T times k, so the loss grows with k.
mutants.no_expert_scale: Forgets the factor E in front of the sum, so a uniform router gives 1 / E.
mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the raw logits, so large logits overflow to infinity.
mutants.softmax_over_all: Uses the full softmax probabilities of the chosen experts as gates without renormalization.
mutants.ties_to_higher_index: Sorts the logits ascending and reverses the order, so ties go to the higher expert index.
